services.name: OC Banana Boat
services.desc: 50 minutes About Get Wet & have a Blast as you TUBE across the waters of Ocean City-- bouncing & power sliding -- on OC' Original & only 12 passenger inflatable Banana raft pulled by our powerboat named Jaws. Our fun-loving, friendly, safety-minded crew will take riders out for some FUN on the water. The excursion takes about 50 minutes, start to finish; including a 10 minute boat ride to the tubing area, 30 minutes of playtime, and a 10 minute return boat ride. We travel up the coast of OC-- family & friends will likely see you from the beach. Rough seas can result in bay rides A 60 minute BANANA BOAT Adventure for up to 12 riders ages 5 & up

faq.q: Do you banana boat in the ocean?
faq.a: -We do go in the ocean and run along the beach, unless the conditions are not suitable then the Captain will treat you to the bay. -Or if everyone on the boat agree, as one group, we ll stay on the bay.
